🪟 Windows 10 & 11 Shortcut Keys in Hindi

Win key (⊞ Windows logo wali key) ke saath yeh shortcuts aapke laptop aur computer ko tez chalane mein madad karte hain. Zyadatar Windows 10 aur 11 dono mein chalte hain.

Is page par 35 shortcuts hain. Search box mein likh kar dhoondo aur Copy dabao.

Windows Keyboard Shortcuts

ShortcutKya hota haiCopy
WinStart menu kholo
Win + DSeedha Desktop dikhao / wapas lao
Win + EFile Explorer kholo
Win + LComputer Lock karo
Win + ISettings kholo
Win + RRun box kholo
Win + SSearch kholo
Win + VClipboard history – pehle copy kiye items dekho
Win + .Emoji panel kholo 😀
Win + Shift + SScreen ka hissa screenshot lo (Snipping)
Win + PrtScnPoori screen ka screenshot Pictures mein save karo
PrtScnPoori screen ka screenshot copy karo
Win + Alt + RScreen recording shuru/band karo (Game Bar)
Win + GXbox Game Bar kholo
Win + HBol kar type karo (Voice typing)
Alt + TabKhule apps ke beech switch karo
Win + TabTask View – saare windows aur desktops dekho
Alt + F4Khula app/window band karo
Ctrl + Shift + EscTask Manager seedha kholo
Win + MSaari windows minimize karo
Win + ↑Window ko maximize karo
Win + ← / →Window ko screen ke aadhe hisse mein lagao (Snap)
Win + Ctrl + DNaya virtual desktop banao
Win + Ctrl + ← / →Virtual desktops ke beech jao
Win + PProjector / dusri screen ka mode chuno
Win + AQuick Settings (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth) kholo
Win + NNotifications aur calendar kholo (Windows 11)
Win + KTV / wireless display par cast karo
Win + XPower user menu (Device Manager, Disk) kholo
Win + +Magnifier se screen zoom karo
F2Selected file ka naam badlo (Rename)
Ctrl + Shift + NNayi folder banao
Shift + DeleteFile ko Recycle Bin ke bina hamesha ke liye delete karo
Alt + EnterSelected file ki Properties dekho
Win + Ctrl + Shift + BDisplay driver restart karo (screen atak jaye to)
